title: TikTok Shop category opened — fit evaluation
narrative: Stages run in order — integration, then listings, then inventory and creative, then the tracking card. A listing cannot go live before the reserved inventory pool exists.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, a breach re-opens this card and waits for you.

plan.name: Integration setup
plan.meta: existing connector · $14K cap · no custom middleware

items.name: Seller app + API credentials
items.detail: Seller account verification and OAuth grant happen in the platform console. Realify stores the token and the refresh schedule.

items.name: Catalogue mapping
items.detail: 15 SKUs mapped to platform category attributes. Three attributes have no equivalent in our data and default to the category norm.

items.name: Inventory sync
items.detail: Two-way, 15-minute interval, with a reserved pool so the pilot cannot oversell the Shopify buffer.

items.name: Order + fulfilment webhook
items.detail: Orders land in the same queue as Walmart. The 3-day handling SLA is tighter than our current 4-day norm, so the queue flags them first.

items.name: Tax and shipping profile
items.detail: Existing nexus configuration reused. Free shipping over $35 matches the site to avoid a MAP-adjacent price difference.

plan.name: Listing batches
plan.meta: 15 listings in 3 batches · brand voice checked · MAP enforced

items.name: Batch A · 7 hero SKUs
items.detail: Skillets, dutch oven, braiser, filter pitcher, chef knife, griddle, kettle. Copy adapted for platform length limits, claims unchanged.

items.name: Batch B · 6 traffic drivers
items.detail: Care kit, filter 3-pack, whetstone, paring knife, spoon set, shears. Priced at MAP with no channel-specific discount.

items.name: Batch C · 2 bundle listings
items.detail: Two bundles that raise AOV above the $34 channel average without discounting a component below MAP.

items.name: MAP and claim check
items.detail: Every listing price checked against MAP and every product claim against the approved claim set before submission.

plan.name: Inventory positioning + agent handoffs
plan.meta: 2,860 units reserved · Planner and Merchandiser briefed

items.name: Reserve pilot units
items.detail: Positioning runs through the demand-forecast flow so the reservation is netted out of the Shopify and Amazon plans rather than double-counted.

items.name: Replenishment trigger
items.detail: Pilot SKUs enter the normal reorder logic at a 21-day cover target, lower than the 35-day site norm because the pilot may end.

items.name: Creative production brief
items.detail: 12 assets a month from the in-house studio, first shoot day Oct 2. Four creators contracted with a flat fee plus 6% affiliate.

items.name: Service and returns routing
items.detail: Platform returns route to the same RMA queue with a separate reason code set, so the pilot’s return rate can be read on its own.

plan.name: Tracking card + gate scheduling
plan.meta: monthly actual-vs-model · gate Dec 22 · wind-down armed

items.name: Business-case tracking card
items.detail: Opens in the workspace with the approved model attached. Each month it posts actuals against the P50 line and names the variance driver.

items.name: 90-day gate scheduled
items.detail: Dec 22, with the scale, continue and kill rules from Decide already written into the card. It arrives as a decision, not a report.

items.name: Cannibalisation cohort
items.detail: A matched control cohort on Shopify DTC starts at listing live, so the 6% ceiling can be measured rather than argued about.

items.name: Wind-down path stored
items.detail: The five-step delist and recall sequence is attached to the pilot, executable in one action if the gate says kill.
